profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Unity
profile.summary: Backend engineer at Unity working in advertising.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer II
positions.description:
I worked in Amazon Advertising, where I designed, built, and maintained large-scale distributed systems and microservices that power core advertising experiences. My work supported critical business use cases like advertiser billing, reporting, and targeting, with systems that operate at high throughput and low latency.

I’ve led the development of several complex features across the full software lifecycle—from design and implementation to deployment, operations, and documentation. I also mentored engineers through code reviews and design discussions, helping to raise the technical bar across the team. My projects often required cross-team collaboration and coordination to integrate with upstream and downstream systems at scale.

Skills: Java, AWS

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Conducted weekly office hours to teach and guide students on approaches towards projects and coursework by introducing them to programming fundamentals and coding etiquette. Also monitored progress of small groups of 5-10 students weekly and held large exam review sessions of 50-100 people. Aided in grading exams for class sections of over 200 students.
